symptom: The Routine overview renders too many historical summaries, making the page noisy and excessively long.
root_cause: The RoutinesPage renders every run returned by the recent-runs endpoint without applying the overview's compact-display boundary.
violated_invariant: The Routine overview must remain a routine-management screen; historical run records remain available through the routine detail history and are not rendered as a second feed on the overview.

fix_boundary.rationale: The API and persisted run history are shared product data and must remain complete; the overview alone owns how much is previewed.

cases.expected_invariant: No historical summary cards are rendered in the overview.
No historical summary cards are rendered even when runs belong to different routines.
The routine management UI remains available when there are no runs to preview.
The fix does not affect routine-card navigation or actions.
